items.headline: Papertrade Keeps $PAPER Locked, Citing Perp Attack Risks
items.summary: Papertrade says $PAPER stays non-transferable for now, fearing perp manipulation. Holders can stake for USDC payouts but have no date to sell or move tokens. #PAPER

items.headline: $FRAX Unveils Six-Currency FX Pools on Aerodrome
items.summary: Frax launched six FX stablecoin pools on Aerodrome on Base. Early traction is modest: ~$241K liquidity and ~$20K in 24h volume — one to watch as onchain FX grows. #FRAX

items.headline: $RUNE: THORChain Targets Rujira Restart With v3.21 Fix
items.summary: THORChain's v3.21 upgrade aims to fix the recent exploit and restart Rujira around Oct. 23. Rujira plans a conditional 24-hour liquidation grace period for borrowers. #RUNE

items.headline: $OUSD Vault Hits $42.5M on New Tempo Chain
items.summary: Sentora's Morpho-based $OUSD lending vault on Tempo already holds $42.5M against cbBTC collateral — though nearly all assets sit idle, signaling fresh-chain yield opportunity. #OUSD

items.headline: $ECHO Shock: Echo Protocol Winds Down, Halts Deposits
items.summary: Echo Protocol is shutting down, halting new deposits and borrowing. Withdrawals stay open, but conflicting November deadlines before collateral liquidation are worrying users. #ECHO
